help.text: usage: cli.py [-h] [--lvgl LVGL] [--app APP] [--record | --no-record] [--record-changed-only | --no-record-changed-only] [--build | --no-build] [--scenario SCENARIO | --idle] [--json] Run a headless LVGL session and optionally play a scenario. arguments: -h, --help show this help message and exit --lvgl LVGL LVGL version, e.g. 9.6 (default: LVGL_AI_LVGL_VERSION or 9.6) --app APP user app variant (forwarded as LVGL_AI_DEMO); with --scenario the scenario's app is used when this flag is omitted --record, --no-record record frames and evidence files (default: on) --record-changed-only, --no-record-changed-only only save frames whose pixels differ from the previous retained frame; web live enables this by default (default: off) --build, --no-build rebuild lvgl_engine from user/app before launch (default: on); --no-build uses an existing build/ engine --scenario SCENARIO scenario JSON file to play after startup --idle keep the session running until Ctrl+C --json print one JSON summary on stdout

scenario JSON file to play after startup

help.text: usage: new_app.py [-h] [--repo-root REPO_ROOT] [--dry-run] [--force] [--json] name Create a user app variant, scenario, and apps[] registration. positional arguments: name app name: ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$ arguments: -h, --help show this help message and exit --repo-root REPO_ROOT repository root (default: the tool's repository root) --dry-run validate and print planned changes without writing --force overwrite generated files and keep registration idempotent --json print exactly one JSON summary on stdout

help.text: usage: web.py [-h] [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--sessions-root SESSIONS_ROOT] [--lvgl LVGL] [--build | --no-build] [--app APP] [--manage] [--open] [--exit-on-close] Serve the session viewer and live bridge. Default address: http://127.0.0.1:8765/ arguments: -h, --help show this help message and exit --host HOST bind address (default: 127.0.0.1) --port PORT TCP port; 0 picks a free port (default: 8765) --sessions-root SESSIONS_ROOT session directory (default: LVGL_AI_SESSIONS_ROOT or <repo>/sessions) --lvgl LVGL LVGL version for live sessions (default: LVGL_AI_LVGL_VERSION or 9.6) --build, --no-build rebuild lvgl_engine for live sessions (default: on); --no-build uses an existing build/ engine --app APP app to preselect and test-preview on page load; the browser URL gets ?app=NAME --manage open the app management dialog on page load; the browser URL gets ?manage=1 --open open the page in a browser after startup (default: off) --exit-on-close exit after the last tracked browser page closes (default: off; core/web.pyw enables it)
